mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (measured as the 3-month change) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods of declining UNRATE are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 310, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to delayed rate cuts or further hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 310, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300, it signals a weakening housing market that may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1300, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) coincides with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0), it signals a regime of delayed rate cuts and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 310 AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (UNRATE > 4.0) and housing starts are low (HOUST < 1300), it signals a weak labor market and housing sector, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0 AND HOUST < 1300, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (as indicated by strong GDP growth, GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: In periods of late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (as indicated by FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 310), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to delayed rate cuts and potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: In periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 310), the 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
